release_amendment.reason: The product policy now uses one persistent explicit reader switch instead of per-question consent.
release_amendment.retention: one browser tab and exact locale until explicit disable, locale change or tab close
release_amendment.server_authority: The renderer presents only the server-validated enabled/available state; the M12A-04 service remains the network authority.

input_boundary.visible_text: The switch label is locale-owned portal copy; provider/model prose never supplies it.

rendering.surface: A native checkbox with role=switch is visible only while the assistant is Ready.
rendering.unavailable: The switch remains visible, unchecked and disabled when administrator configuration does not permit external evidence.
rendering.helper: The presentation helper validates and renders state only; the same-origin transport owns GET/POST and chat submission.
rendering.safe_dom: State is applied through checked, disabled, aria-disabled and data attributes only.

boundaries.page_load: The helper only registers validation/render functions and performs no fetch, status poll, provider request or DOM mutation on its own.
